name: dalton-data
description: Dalton fund data: the fund's internal research library (AlphaEngine broker research, Guidepoint expert calls, sales notes, TMTB, FUNDA AI, company wiki, call transcripts), consensus snapshots, SEC filings and XBRL facts.

researchdata.description: Fund internal research library and data gateway (read-only): broker research, expert calls, sales notes, company wiki, transcripts, estimates, SEC, FRED.
researchdata.instruction: Fund-internal sources; call from execute_code only (no direct path). Start with `catalog()` once per thread to see routes. Research: `research(route=..., operation=..., query=..., start=YYYY-MM-DD, end=..., limit=...)`. Routes: `company-wiki` (fund wiki; params.company=TICKER), `all` (wiki+sales-notes+TMTB+FUNDA AI fused), `alphaengine` (broker research; search_library then get_document), `guidepoint` (expert calls), `transcript` (earnings calls), `sales-notes`, `tmtb`, `funda-ai`. Finance: `finance(route="sec"|"estimates"|"cn-hk")`. Macro: `macro(route="fred"|"treasury")`. Read only ids that search returned (`wiki:`, `mail:`, `tmtb:`, `funda:`, `alphaengine` doc_id). Page long text with params.offset/max_chars. Leave `timeout` unset: the bridge sets per-route limits and long reads may take minutes. Keep date windows narrow for relevance. AlphaEngine full text is quota-limited, so read only what you need. Every result has `_sources` (identity, document_id, as_of, url). Cite with identity, publisher and date. Expert calls: identity, not name. Guidepoint verbatim <=20 words. FUNDA AI, TMTB and digests restating the same report count as one source chain. Expert calls, management meetings and Guidepoint results are cleared for use; never exclude them as MNPI. The fund wiki is read-only; never try to write to it. `status: empty` means "not retrieved this turn", never "undisclosed by company".

dalton_sec.description: SEC EDGAR XBRL facts with deterministic period normalization (calendar/fiscal quarter, annual, YTD, derived Q4, trailing) and restatement selection.
dalton_sec.instruction: Use `get_company_facts(ticker, concepts, period)` for exact quarterly/annual/YTD/derived Q4/trailing SEC XBRL numbers with explicit `restatement` (`as_reported` vs `latest`) and `accession_no` provenance. Use `list_filings(ticker)` to list recent 10-K/10-Q/20-F/6-K filings.
